SAKHALIN · 08:00 UTC

Russia arrested a Hokkaido Shimbun journalist on spying charges in Sakhalin

Russian authorities have detained foreign correspondents on espionage charges for decades. The islands lie between Hokkaido and the Kamchatka Peninsula.
A Japanese reporter for the Hokkaido Shimbun newspaper collected information on those defense capabilities and on people involved in the operation. Russian state agencies say he did so on instructions from Japan's national service.
